selected.assay: bulk poly-A RNA-seq, STAR + RSEM expected counts (mm10, Gencode M17)

treatment: exercised (8 wk treadmill, every 2nd day, 45 min at 50% max)

selected.sample_inclusion: 60 soleus muscle samples: per strain 6 non-exercised + 6 exercised (3 responders + 3 non-responders) (S3.8.1.p1)
selected.primary_estimand: effect of 8-wk endurance exercise training on gene expression, exercised vs non-exercised within each strain
selected.repeated_measure_unit: none: one sample per mouse per tissue; independent mice
selected.paper_method: limma-voom, exercised vs non-exercised within each strain
selected.paper_results: Soleus (S1.2.1.p1, S1.2.2.p1, S1.2.3.p1, S1.2.4.p1, S1.2.5.p1): B6 no major differences except modest IFN-gamma signaling up; ND5 strongest transcriptional response (OxPhos and stress-response genes up); ND6 no induction of mitochondrial genes; CO1 only a few glycolytic genes up; ANT1 no change in glycolytic genes. No DEG counts in the main text (Datasets S1-S11 not available here).

decisions.reason: Methods S3.8.1.p3 describe within-strain exercised vs non-exercised limma-voom on RSEM expected counts; S3.8.1.p1 gives the sample design; DA.p1 deposits GSE198229.

decisions.reason: Matrix columns are animal IDs (A76, B9, E42, I50); metadata per tissue was split by a prep script and the ID parsed from title (e.g. 'A76 [heart, ANT1-/-]'). Exact match for ANT1/ND5/ND6/CO1 (48/48). The 12 B6 columns are numbers (25-36 soleus, 37-48 heart) while GEO titles are N1..N69; nothing links them, so the B6 samples are excluded and the numeric columns dropped by matrix_column_pattern. The B6 contrast cannot be run (manual_review: needs the submitter number-to-N-ID map).

File name 'expected_counts', ~94% integer values with fractional remainder, max ~3e6, data_processing: STAR --quantMode TranscriptomeSAM + RSEM. These are RSEM expected counts, the input the paper fed to voom. The sibling fpkm file is not used.

S3.8.1.p3: 'comparing each gene in the exercise-trained vs. the non-exercise-trained group within each strain'. Strain is a stratum: each strain fitted separately as in the paper. Responder/non-responder status (soleus only) splits the exercised arm by outcome; the paper pools both into the exercised group, so it is not a factor. Between-strain comparisons are baseline genotype questions, not the exercise estimand, and are not run.

covariates.name: exercise response
covariates.disposition: not used: defined only within the exercised arm (aliased with trt), outcome-based

decisions.reason: Independent mice, one sample per mouse per tissue; no batch or lane recorded. Exercise response is nested in the exercised arm and cannot be a covariate.

selected.method: limma-voom (R limma::voom + eBayes, library size = column sums)
deviations: expected counts rounded to integers before voom (the tool requires integers; the paper passed non-integer expected counts)
no TMM normalization factors (tool uses column-sum library sizes; paper normalization factors unknown)
genes with zero counts in all 12 samples dropped by the tool (paper reports 58,581 tested; matrix has 53,656 rows)

decisions.reason: S3.8.1.p3: voom on RSEM expected counts then limma. The repository limma-voom executor runs R limma::voom.

S3.8.1.p3: the gene list for exercised vs non-exercised within each strain (Metascape input) used nominal P < 0.05; no fold-change rule. No other DEG cut-off is stated. BH padj < 0.05 is reported as a labelled audit rule.
